// diagnostic

E0805

`yield` used outside a function declared `Stream<T>`

What

`yield` used outside a function declared `Stream<T>`

Why

`yield` hands a value to a `Stream<T>` consumer, so only a function declared to return `Stream<T>` can use it

Fix

Declare the function as `Stream<T>` before using `yield`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0805: tests/ui/yield_outside_generator.stderr.

Error [jet.YieldOutsideStream]: `yield` outside a generator
  --> tests/ui/yield_outside_generator.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     yield 5
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `yield` hands a value to a `Stream<T>` consumer — only a function declared `Stream<T> ->` may use it
 Fix: Declare `Stream<T> ->` on this function, or remove the `yield`
